newsitem.title: USA: CME May lumber jumps limit, then recedes slightly.
newsitem.headline: CME May lumber jumps limit, then recedes slightly.

text.p: Carryover short covering lifted CME lumber futures into technical buy stops in thin trade and May ran up the daily limit of $10.00 per thousand board feet before meeting resistance, traders said.
At 0924 CST, lumber stood $9.30 to $1.00 per tbf higher with May up most at $373.00 and July up $6.10 at $367.00.

Carryover demand pushed prices through technical resistance with buy stops touched off in May above $370. The market appeared oversold and increased ideas that improving weather will spark greater demand for lumber supported values, they said.
